answer: Because the timing is logged against the island challenge, the whisper audit can replay the haven history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 50 submissions and hold every participant open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which burns the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. Each duplicate costs another 133 dollars in locked collateral and another 2 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
